For VRM and MMD avatars in Cycles

Cycles toon rendering, without rebuilding every material.

Water reflections, dappled sunlight, fisheye lenses. Bring your VRM and MMD avatars into the light and shadow of Cycles. Press a button to convert their materials to a toon look and add outlines. The finishing touches are yours.

Designed for character and cel-look workflows

Move from imported materials to Cycles toon shading faster.

MToon, VRToon, and UnityToon build their shading with the EEVEE-only Shader to RGB node, so they lose their toon look when rendered in Cycles. MMD (MMDShaderDev) materials are also designed for EEVEE display. CyclesTooner replaces these materials with Blender's built-in Toon BSDF, carrying over textures, colors, normals, and transparency where possible.

Convert materials to Toon BSDF

Replace Principled BSDF with Toon BSDF while preserving supported color, UV, normal, alpha, and opacity paths. The converted graph is arranged automatically, with meaningful disconnected nodes retained safely. VRToon conversion prepares its outline weights and Thickness for a later Add Outline operation. UnityToon v1 materials created by Unitypackage Importer carry their base color, normal, and alpha paths into the Cycles-ready setup.

  • Principled BSDF to Toon BSDF
  • MMDShaderDev / mmd_shader conversion
  • VRM MToon conversion
  • VRToon conversion with outline weight preparation
  • Unitypackage Importer UnityToon v1 and Unlit conversion

Generate clean Cycles outlines

Build inverted-hull outline objects from the selected model root using Geometry Nodes, excluding meshes disabled for rendering and keeping internal source collections out of the active View Layer. Converted VRToon models reuse the weights and Thickness prepared during conversion.

  • Object-driven outline targets
  • Automatic CT_Outline weights for per-vertex thickness
  • Reuse prepared VRToon weights and Thickness
  • Refresh and remove outline tools

Tune opacity and smoothness in bulk

Apply opacity and Toon Smooth values across selected objects and child hierarchies, with per-material controls when the active material was converted by CyclesTooner. Per-material toggles finish parts such as eyes and eye whites.

  • Batch opacity slider
  • Batch Smooth slider
  • Per-material adjustment
  • No Shadow toggle for materials that should not cast shadows
  • Emission toggle for an unlit look

Quick start

Convert a model in four steps.

Open the CyclesTooner panel in the Tool tab of the 3D Viewport sidebar (press N).

  1. Save your .blend file before converting.
  2. Select the model's root, such as its Armature or Empty, and click Convert. The selected object and all of its descendants are converted.
  3. Select any object in the model and click Add Outline.
  4. Render with Cycles, then adjust Smooth, Opacity, and the outline color and thickness as needed.

Before you convert

  • Convert removes the original shader. For MToon, MMDShaderDev, VRToon, UnityToon, and Unlit materials, Revert creates a simplified Principled BSDF instead of the original setup.
  • Shade colors, MatCap, rim lighting, specular, and emission are not reproduced by Toon BSDF.
  • Convert removes VRToon outlines but saves their thickness, so Add Outline can rebuild them.
  • Add Outline moves every object in the model hierarchy into a new <root>_Collection.
  • Convert switches the render engine from EEVEE to Cycles.

Blender 4.5 LTS+

Install from the Extension Repository.

  1. Open Blender and go to Edit > Preferences > Get Extensions.
  2. Choose Repositories > Add Remote Repository.
  3. Paste the CyclesTooner repository URL.
  4. Enable update checks and install CyclesTooner from the extension list.

Supported Tools

CyclesTooner can convert materials created or imported with the following third-party tools. These tools are independent projects and are not bundled with CyclesTooner.

  • VRM: MToon materials from VRM Add-on for Blender.
  • MMD: MMDShaderDev / mmd_shader materials from MMD Tools on Blender Extensions.
  • Unitypackage Importer: UnityToon v1 groups and Unlit materials from Unitypackage Importer. CyclesTooner cannot convert lilToon or Poiyomi, which many VRChat avatars use, directly; it converts the materials after Unitypackage Importer has imported the avatar.
  • VRToon: VRToon* shader groups from VRToon Shader Manager.
